verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents automatic user provisioning in which changes to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to connected third-party apps such as Office 365. That covers propagating account changes, including deactivation, to connected apps. It also documents wiping a user's account from mobile devices, but nothing shows that suspending a user kills active sessions or that deprovisioning happens immediately in one action. Missing for 10: documented session revocation on suspend or deactivation, explicit deprovisioning semantics and timing, coverage beyond the named provisioning-app catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, offboarding is one action — deactivating a user kills their sessions and deprovisions their accounts across connected apps immediately

citations.quote: Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
